scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=services/realtime"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n api,web,rt "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=services/realtime"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start --workspace=apps/api" "npm run start --workspace=apps/web" "npm run start --workspace=services/realtime"
